extractions.description: This paper serves as an erratum to a previously published research paper that dealt with techniques for imaging macromolecular tissue volume, susceptibility, and relaxometry maps using MRI. The erratum mainly corrects inaccuracies regarding the number of subjects involved in the study.

primary_category.justification: The paper is an erratum addressing corrections to the number of subjects in a study related to MRI techniques. It does not focus on eco-responsible AI topics.
primary_category.quote: In the abstract, the number of subjects should be changed from 3 to 4.

secondary_categories.justification: The content of the erratum is not related to eco-responsible AI, focusing purely on correcting subject number details in a medical imaging study.
secondary_categories.quote: We regret these errors in our manuscript.

primary_sub_category.quote: In the Methods section 2.1 of the manuscript, the number of subjects should likewise be changed from 3 to 4.
